desc:
CHEX MIX: Snack Mix loaded with fun, flavorful shapes of Chex, pretzels, rye chips, breadsticks and more

SAVORY SNACK MIX: With corn Chex, wheat Chex, pretzels, mini breadsticks and crispy, cheddary crackers in the mix, you'll get cheesy, crunchy and delicious all in one

60% LESS FAT: Chex Mix Cheddar (3.5g fat per 30g serving) has 60% less fat than regular potato chips (10g fat per 30g serving); A great choice for school snacks, a travel food, and more

PARTY FAVORITE: Endless taste and texture combinations make it the perfect party mix snack for get-togethers of all shapes and sizes; Not your standard pub mix, trail mix, or bar snack

CONTAINS: One 8 oz bag of Chex Mix Cheddar Savory Snack Mix
features:
Features

Bold Cheddar Flavor

A savory, cheesy seasoning coats every bite for strong cheddar taste lovers.

Crispy, Crunchy Texture Variety

Includes multiple snack shapes and textures that keep it fun to eat.

Lower in Fat Than Chips

Contains about 60% less fat than regular potato chips, making it a better-for-you option.

Comes ready to eat in a resealable bag—perfect for quick snacking.

Benefits

Satisfies Savory Cravings

Great for those who love cheese snacks but want a lighter option.

Great for Groups

Ideal for road trips, movie nights, parties, or lunchboxes.

Kid-Friendly Snack

Cheesy flavor and fun shapes appeal to both kids and adults.

Provides carbs and light protein for a fast snack on the go.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Whole Wheat, Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (soybean, palm, high oleic soybean and/or high oleic canola), Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Whey, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Sour Cream (cultures, nonfat milk, cream), Yeast, Yeast Extract, Baking Soda, Onion Powder, Cheddar Cheese (milk, salt, cultures, enzymes, annatto extract [for color]), Distilled Monoglycerides, Color (annatto extract, yellow 6, yellow 5 lake), Sodium Sulfite, Yellow Corn Flour, Trisodium Phosphate, Malted Barley Extract, Barley Malt Syrup, Calcium Carbonate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Citric Acid. Freshness Preserved by BHT and TBHQ.
